Its EEG signature shows absence of δ (-10.7 dB, sensitivity=16.2) and absence of β_l (+7.8 dB, sensitivity=11.8).
The δ activity is present in 0% of each epoch (transient), with quiescent eye movements (SEM 0% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with N2 physiology: confirmed: σ elevated, EOG quiescent; missing: σ relevant.
